title: POST /api/task/<item-id>/<action> request bodies
description: One def per endpoint, named after it (hyphens become underscores). Every POST sends Content-Type application/json, header X-Todoimpl-Token (CSRF, from the page's meta tag) and a same-origin Origin. Answer: response.schema.json.

auto_ship.description: Start/Restart only: ship without a Ship click once every check is green (done_check notes). Omitted (Retry, Hand back): keep the run's stored choice.

start.description: Start the next stage chain (Spec or Plan).

answers.description: Question id (Q1..) to answer text; may be partial.

ship.description: Ship click: rebase, recheck, commit, push, close note.

go.description: Go click on a permission block: runs the card's one-line command as kuhy, reruns the stage on exit 0.

rerun.description: Done, rerun: kuhy ran the command himself.

credits_fallback.description: POST /api/settings/credits-fallback (not task-scoped): turn the free API credits fallback on or off for every run.
